releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.0 — Read Receipts (Double Cyan Ticks), Clean Top Bar, Background Consolidated Notifications & Pull-Down Refresh
releaseNotes:
• Read Receipts (Double Blue/Cyan Ticks): Fixed delivery tick calculation and read status reconciliation so sent messages immediately flip to double cyan ticks when read or replied to.
• Clean Top Bar UI: Moved Search and Theme options into the three-dot overflow menu, giving contact names full width without truncation.
• Background & Grouped Notifications: Continuous background sync for incoming messages and calls when outside the app; strictly consolidated into a single message notification and single call notification.
• Pull-Down Refresh: Added native Material 3 pull-down refresh to chat to instantly force-sync messages and read receipts.
